name: multi-agent-shogun
description: ChatGPT Work-native multi-agent orchestration inspired by Multi-Agent Shogun.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate complex work to a coordinated agent team.
interface.longDescription: Runs a ChatGPT Work-native Shogun formation: one lead agent plans and integrates while up to three subagents execute independent research, implementation, and review tasks in parallel.
defaultPrompt: Use the Shogun formation to complete this task in parallel.
Delegate research, implementation, and review to separate agents.
Use a multi-agent team and return one verified result.
